STEP 6. Replace the input shaft speed sensor.
(1) Replace the input shaft speed sensor. Refer to GROUP 
23B, Transaxle P.23B-11.
(2) Carry out a test drive.
(3) Read in the A/T diagnostic trouble code.
Q: Is the A/T diagnostic trouble code output?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : The inspection is complete.
STEP 7. Replace the underdrive clutch retainer.
(1) Replace the underdrive clutch retainer. Refer to GROUP 
23B, Underdrive Clutch and Input Shaft P.23B-54.
(2) Carry out a test drive.
(3) Read in the A/T diagnostic trouble code.
Q: Is the A/T diagnostic trouble code output?
YES : The A/T diagnostic trouble code may have set due to 
external radio frequency (RFI), possibly caused by 
cellular phone activity, after market components 
installed on the vehicle, etc.
NO : The inspection is complete.
